summary: Tested A2G modules backend integration (Step 1). All 6 modules (Contacts, Calendar, Tasks, Radio, AndGo, Booking) are properly wired and functional. Fixed route ordering bug in andgo_routes.py where /goto-links/reorder was being matched by /goto-links/{link_id}.

minor.issue: Route was being matched by /goto-links/{link_id} due to FastAPI route ordering. FIXED by moving reorder route before {link_id} route.

critical_code_review_comments: contacts_routes.py: Well-structured CRUD with proper user isolation via user_id filtering
calendar_routes.py: Auto-creates default calendar if none exist - good UX
tasks_routes.py: Includes comments and push-status for external sync - comprehensive
radio_routes.py: External API integration with proper error handling (returns empty array on failure)
andgo_routes.py: Fixed route ordering - reorder must be defined BEFORE {link_id} to avoid conflict
booking_routes.py: Public booking endpoints work without auth, proper slot conflict detection (409)
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up during tests (contacts, calendars, events, tasks, links, bookings)
context_for_next_testing_agent: A2G modules Step 1 backend wiring complete and tested. All endpoints functional: Contacts CRUD, Calendar (calendars/events/categories), Tasks (CRUD/comments/push-status), Radio (search/featured/tune), AndGo (goto-links CRUD/reorder), Booking (settings/link/public booking/meetings). Route ordering fix applied to andgo_routes.py.

bug_fix_applied.issue: PUT /api/goto-links/reorder was being matched by PUT /api/goto-links/{link_id} because FastAPI matches routes in definition order
